projects.name: HYDRA
projects.line: All-pairs shortest paths on MPI + OpenMP + CUDA.
bullets: Density-aware dispatch sends each 32x32 tile to GPU or CPU.
Beat 8 reimplemented published methods, up to 90x.
Bit-exact against the sequential reference; losses reported.
projects.cond: vs Sao et al.'s 2.5D on ego-Facebook: 217.93 s vs 2.42 s, same cluster.

projects.name: LCS on GPU
projects.line: Longest common substring of two 10⁸-character strings.
bullets: No O(NM) table: suffix arrays by prefix doubling on the GPU.
CUDA 0.649 s vs best 72-thread OpenMP 2.029 s.
30 trials plus 5 warm-ups; 0.0029 s standard deviation.
projects.cond: CUDA prefix doubling 0.649 s vs the best OpenMP configuration 2.029 s (k-mer index + AVX2).

projects.name: Face-wise tensor product
projects.line: Four backends for the product behind t-SVD.
bullets: Serial, OpenMP, CUDA and hybrid CPU+GPU backends.
Up to 18.66x over serial; 3.71x CUDA on dense 4000x4000x12.
Validated across a 700-run scalability matrix.
projects.cond: Hybrid backend, 5000x5000x100 tensor, 64 threads, on a 36-core node with an RTX A5000.

projects.name: K-means + SpMV
projects.line: OpenMP K-means and MPI SpMV on a 760.6 M-nonzero matrix.
bullets: K-means: 7.19x on 32 threads, identical centroids.
Showed dynamic scheduling can lose to serial (0.39x).
SpMV: 21.90x on 128 processes across six nodes.
projects.cond: Strong scaling of MPI SpMV on the NLPKKT240 matrix, 128 processes across six nodes.

projects.name: DFT-FE on CLAP
projects.line: Routed DFT-FE's 8 GEMM overloads through CLAP's 4.
bullets: Configure-time switch; bit-identical to upstream when off.
CLAP headers isolated behind one shim header.
Verification and timing layer on real call shapes.

projects.name: Air-B-N-C
projects.line: Write characters in thin air; edge devices read them.
bullets: IMU, camera and depth branches each infer on the edge.
A central node fuses them over 62 character classes.
Team of 3; I built the IMU firmware and vision classifier.

projects.name: SFT, DPO, GRPO
projects.line: Fine-tuned a small language model on math word problems.
bullets: SFT trainer from scratch: masking, shifted cross-entropy.
DPO on preference pairs; GRPO with group rewards.
Scored by pass@1 and pass@k (k = 5).

projects.name: Wrist IMU HAR
projects.line: Activity recognition from a wrist IMU on a Nicla Vision.
bullets: MicroPython firmware at a drift-corrected 60 Hz.
12 activities, 26,819 windows, 126 features.
Chose a 94.48% tree over a 97.35% forest: 134.9 KB.

projects.name: VOC vision
bullets: PCA from scratch: 170 of 3072 components keep 95%.
ResNet50 with an FPN-style head: val F1@0.5 = 0.812.
ConvNeXt + DeepLabV3+ for 21 classes, Wilcoxon-tested.

projects.name: Video2PDF
projects.line: Lecture videos to deduplicated slide PDFs.
bullets: Slide changes by pixel-difference ratio, 5-frame stability.
Near-duplicates dropped by MSE similarity.
Local files or YouTube URLs.

projects.name: ISDC 2026 site
projects.line: TypeScript site for IISc's Durga Puja (ISDC 2026).
bullets: Built while on the committee, finances included.
Also built the CDS farewell 2026 site.

projects.name: Trojan GNN
projects.line: Golden-reference-free hardware Trojan detection with GNNs.
bullets: GNNs on data-flow graphs of RTL and gate-level netlists.
Clean and Trojan-inserted 16-bit ALU in Verilog.
Self-reported: 97% recall at RTL, 84% at gate level.

projects.name: Logic locking
projects.line: Logic locking a 16-bit ALU against Trojan insertion.
bullets: Cadence Genus/Tempus scripts flag likely insertion sites.
XOR/XNOR key gates harden them against SAT attacks.
B.Tech final-year project, graded A+.

projects.name: Face login
projects.line: Log in with facial key-points instead of a password.
bullets: Live detection for higher security.
Python/OpenCV back end, React + Bootstrap front end.

projects.name: IISc innovation archive
projects.line: A queryable archive of IISc's innovation history.
bullets: Five pillars, from startups to eminent faculty.
NotebookLM-grounded workflow into one master database.
Owned three divisions; interviewed a retired professor.
